articles.text: ĀNDÉSĒN FŪREN: Qǐngwèn, nǐ shi zài nǎr shēngde?
MRS. ANDERSON: May I ask, where were you born?
ZHĀNG TÓNGZHÌ: Wǒ shi zài Běijīng shēngde. Nǐ ne?
COMRADE ZHĀNG: I was born in Běijīng. And you?
ĀNDÉSĒN FŪREN: Wǒ shi zài Dézhōu shēngde. Nǐ shi něinián shēngde?
MRS. ANDERSON: I was born in Texas. What year were you born?
ZHĀNG TÓNGZHÌ: Wǒ shi Yījiǔsānjiǔnián shēngde. Wǒ shi Qīyuè sìhào shēngde.
COMRADE ZHĀNG: I was born in 1939. I was born on July 4th.
ĀNDÉSĒN FŪREN: Nǐmen háizi jǐsuì le?
MRS. ANDERSON: How old are your children?
ZHĀNG TÓNGZHÌ: Yíge jiǔsuì le, yíge liùsuì le. Nǐmen nǚháizi ne?
COMRADE ZHĀNG: One is nine, and one is six. And your daughter?
ĀNDÉSĒN FŪREN: Tā bāsuì le. Nǐmen xīngqījǐ zǒu?
MRS. ANDERSON: She's eight. What day of the week are you leaving?
ZHĀNG TÓNGZHÌ: Wǒmen Xīngqītiān zǒu. Xièxie.
COMRADE ZHĀNG: We're leaving on Sunday. Thank you.
